evidence.claim: The same matrix evaluated by established reference node-semver 7.6.3 maxSatisfying. Selections must be identical per case, not averaged.
A yanked version stays resolvable from an existing lockfile pin.

negative_controls.description: Yanked 1.2.0 is excluded from fresh ^1.0.0 (selects 1.1.0). The same catalog with yanked=false on 1.2.0 selects 1.2.0. Detector fires on bad state and is silent on good state.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0070. Live named probes re-run. Per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json only. Did not run tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write. Did not git mutate. cloud ok=true is not this delivery.
question_or_target: Implement semantic-version parsing, range resolution (caret, tilde, exact, prerelease policy) and yank semantics where a yanked version stays resolvable for an existing lockfile but is never selected for a new install.

reviewer.observation: Python string compare ranks '1.0.0-alpha.10' < '1.0.0-alpha.2'. SemVer identifier compare ranks alpha.10 > alpha.2. Probe 2 asserts both facts and that 1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0. Probe 1 is a different process (node-semver oracle) and does not perform this check.
reviewer.requirement: Reviewer must confirm prerelease precedence follows the declared spec and is not left to string comparison.

spec.prerelease_policy: A prerelease satisfies a range only when a comparator in that set also names a prerelease of the same major.minor.patch tuple (node-semver default, includePrerelease=false). Identifier compare is numeric for [0-9]+ ids; numeric ids have lower precedence than non-numeric; a release outranks any prerelease of the same tuple. This is not string comparison of the raw tag.
spec.range_dialect: npm node-semver 7.6.3 (caret, tilde, exact, x, hyphen, ||, AND)
spec.yank: Fresh install: yanked versions are excluded from the candidate set before max_satisfying. Lockfile pin: the pinned version remains resolvable even when yanked, so yanking cannot break reproducibility of past builds.

tests.assertions: 30-case matrix vs node-semver; prerelease vs string; build metadata

title: Version model, range resolution, and yank semantics
